subject: Exception condition handling
notes: kb/Work PB1118 (landed). cite.py --check 14.6.13.2 'When the internal format of a dynamic-length elementary item is not correctly formed or does not agree with the corresponding DYNAMIC LENGTH clause' -> OK 14.6.13.2 5). A dynamic-length item is a managed string (always correctly formed); it disagrees only by exceeding THIS description's 8.5.1.10.1 maximum, which content stored through the same description never does (every store truncates). So the two reads through a description that does not own the storage ask it: a LINKAGE item (PlaceRenderer.Read MemberPlace arm, ReadsForeignDynamicLength - a formal occupies the argument's storage, 14.2.3 GR8) and a cell-backed DynSlotWindow member (an EXTERNAL record described in two programs). CobolDynString.Agree raises the fatal condition under checking; checking off reads the content whole. Witness: pb1118_dyn_length_agreement (BY REFERENCE LIMIT 10 -> LIMIT 4: HANDLED, W4 unchanged; 2 chars agree; EXTERNAL LIMIT 10 vs 4; unchecked callee reads ABCD). Determination: docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 4.2.6 entry 'Incompatible dynamic-length and dynamic-capacity data'.
